title: A strict four-row permanent inequality and permutation moments
main_claim: Thm 1.1: there are p0 in (4/3,2) and eps>0 such that any law nu on S_4 within TV eps of uniform and with exactly uniform coordinate marginals satisfies E_nu prod f_i(pi(i)) <= prod ||f_i||_{p0}. Thm 1.2: for some fixed even r and eta>0, D_lambda Tr B_N(lambda)^r <= D_lambda^{1-eta} for every dyadic N and every lambda. Consequently O(1) sweeps, i.e. O(log N) physical Thorp shuffles, mix the deck, which is optimal order.

issues.location: Sec. 6, proof of Lemma 6.1 (tree budget), lower-order cost displays
issues.description: The bounds m^a sqrt(K/N) sqrt(q_m K) <= K m^{-delta} (and the companion bound) leave out the log(2m) factor carried by the lower-order restriction cost. The corrected terms K m^{-delta} log(2m) still sum over the geometric levels m > M/4 to a total that tends to 0 as M grows, so the conclusion stands.
issues.evidence: Lemma 4.2 cost is C(1+h)(1+sqrt k)log(2m); the display then drops the log when bounding by K m^{-delta}.

coverage:
Read and checked the whole paper (secs 1-7).

Sec 2 (Thm 1.1):
- Quadratic identity verified numerically.
- Local Taylor gap (p-1)/2 > 1/6 checked.
- Cubic and quartic terms checked via Cauchy-Schwarz with uniform marginals.
- Compactness/continuity step using the CLL equality case checked.
- Tensorization by induction checked.
- Holder interpolation for PSD stochastic U checked.
- Random numerical test of the uniform-law inequality at p=1.8 run.

Sec 3 (four-row recursion):
- Split B_N = M A M^* checked.
- ALT exponent bookkeeping, giving Tr(XYXY), checked.
- Isotype projections and the HS triangle inequality checked.
- Regular-trace expansion and the AM-GM coefficient bound checked.
- Cyclic symmetry and inversion invariance checked.
- Coloring equivalence bpc in H <=> zeta(pz)=eta(z) checked.
- Column-by-column application of the tensorization lemma (2m independent permutations, laws omega and omega^{-1}, uniform marginals) checked.
- PSD of U_i via positive-definite |xi|^2 checked.
- N!/(m!)^4 <= 4^N checked.

Sec 4 (multiplicities):
- Color-trace lemma (partial-trace argument, a_nu bound, Frobenius) checked.
- c^2 <= multinomial checked.
- Pieri containment of V_alpha in W after removing h rows and h columns checked.
- Tail budget from the LR first-row inequality and the Q_m(k) count checked.
- Mackey allocation count and exponent bookkeeping checked.
- Supersymmetric hook-Schur argument for t_h superadditivity, plus the k superadditivity, checked.

Sec 5 (sparse stopping):
- Branching multiplicity binom(s,j)D_mu checked.
- Path/coin identity a_s = (n)_s/n^s E 2^e checked.
- Coupled inclusion-exclusion and covering identity checked.
- Edge bound (v/2)log v via entropy checked.
- Forest placement probability and the counting/exponent arithmetic giving n^{-3k/10} checked.
- Column case via Young's rule checked.

Sec 6 (tree budget and hook comparison):
- Charged-node counts checked.
- Choice of h_m and the lower-order sums checked.
- Per-box level count giving (theta/a)(R_H + (K/2)log(N/K)) checked.
- Hook-length first-row identity and the E_{N,K} cases checked.
- Reverse linear extension bound R_H <= log D_zeta + 4K/H checked.
- log D >= cK in all three cases checked.
- Final constant ordering, giving eta = (1-b)/2, checked.

Sec 7 (amplification):
- Schatten-Holder bound ||T^q||_HS^2 <= ||B||^{q-r} Tr B^r checked.
- Degree-sum dominated convergence checked.
- Plancherel/Cauchy-Schwarz TV bound checked.

Took on trust: the CLL n=4 equality classification and the ALT inequality as cited.
sibling_notes: Self-contained; it does not rely on the family-238 companions. The sibling Optimal-order Thorp paper proves the same O(d) mixing result by a different route (flows plus trimming), and that sibling was also marked no_gap. Read together, the two papers give independent proofs of the same result. The sparse encounter-forest estimate here looks like the 'forest estimate' in the Row-column-symmetry and Signed-tensor siblings.
